lines.t: How to use this book
Every Day
Do the 3 pages in order: READ, STORY, WRITE (15-20 minutes). Stop at 20 minutes, even if a page is not done.
Not sure how to say a word? Scan the QR code on the page and listen first.
LISTEN AND CIRCLE first: scan the QR code and tap 1 to 6. She hears the sound and circles the first or the second choice. If you can't use the phone, read the words from the key.
SAY IT: say the sound with her. For c and g use the mirror: tongue tip down, back of the tongue up. Never a hand on the throat.
LISTEN AND BLEND: on the QR page, tap speaker 1, 2, 3. She listens, says the word fast and circles the picture on this page. If you can't use the phone, say the sounds from the key.
READ THE WORDS 3 times, then THE SENTENCES once: her finger slides to the LAST letter before she says each word. She colors a circle each time.
If she misreads: point to the letter and say "Look again." Do not say the word for her.
STORY: she reads it once. Then ask the 3 TALK questions (answers in the key).
WRITE: read each instruction to her. Day 3 test: read the 5 words and the sentence from the key. Check with the key.
Check Day
No hints today. If she is stuck, wait 5 seconds, then point to the next word.
Part A: she reads the 10 words. Mark each one right or wrong. She needs 9 of 10.
Part B: read the 5 spelling words from the key. She needs 4 of 5.
Part C: she reads the story. She may miss no more than the number printed.
Scoring: self-corrected = right; sounded out, then said right = right; skipped, wrong, or said for her = miss. The same word missed again counts once. Names (Pam, Tim, Dan) do not count.
All 3 passed = PASSED: color the PASSED circle on My Path and a tile on the certificate.
NOT YET: do the retake set for that unit (at the back of the book), then its retake check, before the next unit.
Still NOT YET: stop and message Teacher Omar with a photo of the check page.
Retake (after NOT YET)
Day 1: do every box on retake page 1. Listen and circle is on the QR page, as on Day 1. Leave "Cover and write again" empty.
Day 2: she reads the words and sentences again. Then she covers the words and writes them in "Cover and write again".
Day 3: the retake check on the next page. No hints.
Tips
Say the sound, not the letter name (/k/, not "see").
Praise the finger slide: "You read to the END!"
Little and often beats long: 15 minutes every day.
Small gray text with an ear icon: you read it to her.
The s may sound like /z/ (beds, cars, runs). Both are right. She must say it.
